edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the recipient of _safeMint, so the caller address controls the callback target.
withdraw is gated by onlyOwner which compares owner() to _msgSender().
mintBAIByOwner is gated by onlyOwner which compares owner() to _msgSender().
changeBaseURI is gated by onlyOwner which compares owner() to _msgSender().
setProvenanceHash is gated by onlyOwner which compares owner() to _msgSender().
withdraw forwards the full contract balance to msg.sender via an external transfer.
mintBAI calls _safeMint which invokes the onERC721Received callback on the recipient.
mintBAIByOwner calls _safeMint which invokes the onERC721Received callback on the recipient.
_safeMint delegates the receiver check to _checkOnERC721Received.
_checkOnERC721Received performs an external functionCall to the token recipient contract.
mintBAI mints each token through _safeMint.
mintBAIByOwner mints each token through _safeMint.
mintBAI calls getBAIPrice and multiplies it by requestedAmount to compare against msg.value.
BAI_SUPPLY bounds the total supply arithmetic inside mintBAI.
getBAIPrice checks totalSupply() against BAI_SUPPLY before pricing.
BAI_SUPPLY bounds the total supply arithmetic inside mintBAIByOwner.
mintBAI writes startingIndexBlock once the reveal block is reached or supply is exhausted.
mintBAI sets _mintedBeforeReveal for tokens minted before the reveal block.
isMintedBeforeReveal reads the _mintedBeforeReveal mapping.
finalizeStartingIndex reads startingIndexBlock to derive the shuffling index.
finalizeStartingIndex writes the computed startingIndex value.
finalizeStartingIndex requires startingIndex to still be zero.
setProvenanceHash writes the BAI_PROVENANCE state variable.
requestedAmount is validated and multiplied in mintBAI before minting.
requestedAmount is validated in mintBAIByOwner before minting.
baseURI parameter flows into _setBaseURI inside changeBaseURI.
provenanceHash parameter flows into the BAI_PROVENANCE write.
getBAIPrice assigns block.number to the local currentBlockNumber used for tier comparison.
mintIndex is computed from totalSupply() inside the mintBAI loop.
balance local is read from address(this).balance and forwarded to msg.sender.

normalization_plan.reason: requestedAmount is a mintBAI/mintBAIByOwner parameter consumed only by the supply and payment checks; it should be folded into the mintBAI core function.
baseURI is a temporary parameter used only to update the base URI; it should be merged into changeBaseURI.
provenanceHash is a temporary parameter used only to store the provenance hash; it should be merged into setProvenanceHash.
currentBlockNumber is a local cache of block.number inside getBAIPrice and should be merged into that function.
mintIndex is a loop-local token id inside mintBAI and should be merged into the mintBAI core function.
balance is a local copy of the contract balance used by the withdrawal transfer inside withdraw and should be merged into withdraw.
